Fed official discusses AI's potential economic impact

Federal Reserve official Kevin Warsh has discussed the potential impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the U.S. economy, suggesting it could help sustain "substantially higher" growth. However, Warsh also indicated that the economic outcomes related to AI might "disappoint" both optimistic and pessimistic predictions. The Federal Reserve is reportedly gaming out how AI could reshape the economy.
